title: Outer-2 dynamic response divergence decomposition
question: What causes the preregistered G21 outer-2 accepted-head divergence of 7.215394948190124e-11 m: dynamic E3/response-parameter sensitivity, continuous prepared-solve path dependence, or the 4.440892098500626e-16 m outer-1 head offset?
experiments: Using one G16 immutable-origin session, independently estimate E3 and q_swap at the exact G17 outer-1 head and exact G21 outer-1 head. Preserve all G09D/G13 E3 rules.
For each anchor, construct the lambda=1 affine response from that anchor's own q_swap and dynamically estimated E3 tangent.
Solve each response in a fresh live MODFLOW model from the same accepted groundwater origin and record the settled head.
Compute the analytical affine root h + r/(a-p) for each response and compare it with the corresponding fresh live solution.
Replay the frozen outer-1 lambda sequence [1,1/2,1/4] inside one continuous prepared solve, then apply the exact G21 outer-2 response in that same solve and record its settled head.
Compare the continuous outer-2 head with the fresh solution for the identical G21 response. This isolates prepared-solve path dependence from response-parameter differences.
Cross-evaluate the G17 tangent at the G21 anchor and the G21 tangent at the G17 anchor to quantify tangent versus anchor/q-reference sensitivity algebraically and with fresh solves.
gates: All G16 observations remain non-authoritative and use zero ordinary publication-path participant trials.
Fresh live heads agree with their analytical affine roots within 1e-12 m.
The identical-response continuous-versus-fresh head difference is reported without post-hoc acceptance threshold changes.
The E3 mode, selected scale, slope and current residual are reported at both anchors.
A numerical decomposition accounts for the observed G21 outer-2 divergence to within 1e-12 m using measured response variants; otherwise the cause remains unresolved.
No G21, G17, E3, P4, F-GC38/F-GC39 or production HCOF/RHS rule is modified.

interpretation_rules.response_parameter_dominated: If the fresh G21-response head already differs from the G17 reference by approximately the observed G21 divergence while identical-response continuous-versus-fresh difference is <=1e-12 m.
interpretation_rules.prepared_solve_path_dominated: If the fresh G21-response head remains within 1e-12 m of the G17 reference but the continuous identical-response head reproduces the G21 divergence.
interpretation_rules.mixed: If both effects exceed 1e-12 m and materially contribute.
interpretation_rules.unresolved: If measured components do not account for the observed divergence within 1e-12 m.
